product_one_liner.value: Eden provides a cloud-native, AI-powered medical imaging operating system that unifies imaging workflows, viewing and reporting for radiologists and health systems.
product_one_liner.notes: Eden describes a cloud-native replacement for PACS, RIS, viewing and reporting tools, orchestration across health systems, and AI-generated report drafts for radiologists: https://edenmed.com/technology and https://edenmed.com/.

pricing_page.notes: The homepage navigation and footer contain no pricing link or plans and direct buyers to book a demo. The checked /pricing address returned no readable page: https://edenmed.com/.
